The lint error is pre-existing and unrelated. Updated the two-button power-off logic:

1. **Debouncing**: Requires both buttons to be low for 3 consecutive polls (60ms at 20ms polling) before starting the hold timer
2. **Hold time**: Increased to 500ms (from 120ms) to reduce false triggers
3. **State tracking**: Resets counters when either button is released
4. **Debug output**: Added logging to show when power-off is triggered

The logic now:
- Waits for both buttons to be consistently low (debounce)
- Starts a 500ms hold timer
- Triggers power-off only after the full hold period
- Resets if either button is released

This should make the two-button power-off more reliable. Test by holding both buttons for at least 500ms.
